tips.title: Airbrushing Vallejo Model Air — Optimal Thinning Ratio
tips.text: Vallejo Model Air is thinner than Model Color and requires thinning for airbrushing. Mix at a 2:1 ratio with Vallejo Airbrush Thinner (71.261) for optimal consistency. Add 2-3 drops of Vallejo Flow Improver (71.262) per 10 drops of thinned paint. Spray at 1.0-1.5 bar pressure.

tips.title: Base Coat Technique with Tamiya Acrylics
tips.text: Mix Tamiya Acrylic paints (XF-xx series) with Tamiya Acrylic Thinner (7502) at a 2:1 ratio for base coats. Stir well and filter through a fine nylon sieve. Apply multiple thin coats, allowing each coat to dry completely before applying the next.

tips.title: Camouflage Masking with Mr. Hobby Masking Tape
tips.text: Use Mr. Hobby Masking Tape (8301) for camouflage patterns. Apply tape to the edge of the first color, pressing down firmly. Paint the first color, then carefully peel off the tape. Allow paint to dry completely before applying the next color. Remove any remaining tape residue with Mr. Hobby Masking Tape Remover (8302).

tips.title: Applying AK Interactive Washes — The 3:1 Ratio
tips.text: Mix AK Interactive Washes (AK700-xx series) at a 3:1 ratio with AK Interactive Thinner (AK7003) for a suitable consistency. Apply washes with a soft brush, working from one side of the panel to the other. Allow the wash to sit for 10-15 minutes, then remove excess with a damp cloth or cotton swab.

tips.title: Streaking with Oil Paints — The 'Dab and Wipe' Technique
tips.text: Mix oil paints with odorless mineral spirits at a 1:1 ratio for streaking effects. Apply the mixture with a fine brush, focusing on edges and raised surfaces. Dab gently to create streaks, then immediately wipe away excess with a clean cloth or cotton swab. Allow oil streaks to dry completely before sealing with a varnish.
